pair_result.reasoning: Lawrence (82) vs Mac Jones (77), ceiling-check tiebreak. On paper Jones leads dropback-weighted EPA/dropback (+.127 vs +.114 over 2025-26), CPOE (+3.7 vs -0.4) and sack rate (5.3% vs 6.7%). But Jones's sample is 11 fill-in starts in 2025 and zero 2026 attempts, built on play-action (+.35 vs non-PA +.08) and YAC (share .445), with a negative deep game (-.25) and collapse when hit (-1.00). Lawrence's 2026 is elite (EPA/db +.282, CPOE +3.9, 17 TD / 4 INT in 7 games), he leads PFF (80.7 vs 76.7), availability (24 vs 11 games) and turnover-worthy rate (3.0% vs 3.8%), and adds rushing value (+26.8 rush EPA 2025). Lawrence wins clearly.
